title: Hash index over the extent cache once N > 32: fn-xc-find, -find-free and -lru are linear scans, so books/extent-cache.lisp refuses a profile figure above 32 (*fn-xc-max-slots*, and a theorem on the :extent-cache-entries/:extent-cache-windows rows). Owed: a generated hash index (def-representation keyed instance) with lookup/install/yield decisions proved equal to the scan's, then raise the bound. Until then the profile cannot name more than 32 slots.
